answer: Make every claim pass through a vault before it counts: an agent locks a small bond in escrow and publishes its work to an oasis, a public pool where random peers re-execute a sample and compare results. Pass, and the bond returns plus a vine of trust grows, linking the agent to the peers who verified it. Fail or vanish, and the bond is slashed. A sybil farmer must fund a vault bond and survive real re-execution for every clone, while one honest agent posts once and keeps its vine growing.
